gp.message:
================================================================================
FLEX GUI PRO YA AFTER EFFECTS - IBISHYA BIRIMO
Verisiyo 9.2.9  -  Ukwakira 2026
================================================================================

INSANGANYAMATSIKO 33 NSHYA ZA ANIME zije zisanga iza Demon Slayer, effects za mouse z'insanganyamatsiko ubu
zigaragara koko muri After Effects, kandi Guhitamo Insanganyamatsiko ni urutonde rumwe rufunguka ruteguye neza.

MBERE YO GUTANGIRA
- Shyiraho hejuru ya verisiyo ufite ukoresheje ZXP installer usanzwe, hanyuma
  ongera utangire After Effects rimwe.
- Igenamiterere ryawe, insanganyamatsiko, presets n'expressions wabitse biragumaho.

NSHYA: INSANGANYAMATSIKO 33 ZA ANIME
- Igenamiterere rya Flex > GUHITAMO INSANGANYAMATSIKO > INSANGANYAMATSIKO YA PANEL ubu rifite itsinda rimwe kuri buri anime:
  Attack on Titan (Levi), Berserk (Guts), Black Clover (Asta),
  Bleach (Ichigo, Hitsugaya), Chainsaw Man (Denji, Reze), Code Geass (Lelouch),
  Dandadan (Okarun), Death Note (Kira), Dragon Ball (Goku), Frieren,
  Fullmetal Alchemist (Edward), Hunter x Hunter (Killua, Kurapika, Hisoka),
  Jujutsu Kaisen (Gojo, Sukuna), KonoSuba (Megumin), Mob Psycho 100 (Mob),
  My Hero Academia (Bakugo, Deku, Todoroki), Naruto (Itachi, Minato),
  One Piece (Luffy, Zoro, Law), One-Punch Man (Saitama), Re:Zero (Rem),
  Solo Leveling (Jinwoo), Spy x Family (Anya) na Tokyo Ghoul (Kaneki).
- Buri mukinnyi afite isura ye bwite: igikurikira mouse yawe, igitero iyo
  ukanze buto, ibiba igihe ukomeje gufata buto y'ibumoso, ndetse
  n'iturika nyuma yo gufata nk'amasegonda 2.5.
- Byoroheje nk'insanganyamatsiko za Demon Slayer: effects zikora gusa iyo wimura mouse
  cyangwa ukanda. Zimya EFFECTS Z'IBIDUKIKIJE kugira ngo usigarane amabara gusa.

BIHINDUWE: GUHITAMO INSANGANYAMATSIKO
- Amakarita ya Demon Slayer yari munsi ya INSANGANYAMATSIKO YA PANEL yavuyeho, bityo
  Igenamiterere rya Flex ryabaye rigufi. Hitamo insanganyamatsiko zose mu rutonde rufunguka rwa
  INSANGANYAMATSIKO YA PANEL; rufungukira ku nsanganyamatsiko urimo ukoresha.
- Kurama na Baryon ubu biri mu itsinda rya Naruto.

BYAKOSOWE
- Effects za mouse z'insanganyamatsiko (amazi, ibirimi by'umuriro, imirabyo n'ibindi) akenshi
  ntizagaragaraga muri After Effects, kabone n'iyo Uburyo Bunogejwe (Optimised Mode) bwabaga buzimye.
  Ibihe panel ubwayo yabaga ihuze, n'itangira riremereye, byafatwaga nk'aho insanganyamatsiko
  itinda, bityo effects zikizimya ubwazo. Ubu, iyo ikarita ya graphics yawe ari yo izishushanya
  (mudasobwa nyinshi), ibyo bihe bituma effects zoroha mu kanya gato gusa.

NTA CYAHINDUTSE
- Uruhushya, activation n'imiyoboro yose bikora nk'uko byahoze.
- Insanganyamatsiko 11 za Demon Slayer zisa neza neza nk'uko zari ziri muri 9.2.8.
- Izindi tabs n'ibikoresho byose bikora nk'uko byakoraga muri 9.2.8.
================================================================================

- Iyo SHYIRA FOOTER KU MURONGO yabaga yazimijwe mu Igenamiterere rya Flex, ubutumwa bwo kwemeza
  ntibwashoboraga kugaragara na gato. Ubu buhora bugaragara.
- Urutonde rufunguka rwa INSANGANYAMATSIKO YA PANEL rwashoboraga gukomeza kwerekana izina
  ry'insanganyamatsiko ya kera nyuma y'uko ihindutse. Ubu ruhora rwerekana insanganyamatsiko iriho.
